basis: active material as % of the fragrance concentrate
rule: ceiling = the lowest of: the IFRA Category 4 limit divided by 0.20 (6000 uL of concentrate in a 30 mL bottle); the highest maximum a supplier states for perfume compounds; and a project rule (Hedione 15%). Supplier averages and figures whose basis is unclear are not maxima and are not used.

not_set.Iso E Super: IFRA limit gives 100% of concentrate; the only stated maximum is a tolerance remark (up to 50%).
not_set.Ambrox Super / Ambrofix: only supplier averages (0.1%) and an unclear-basis range; usually weighed as crystals.
not_set.Vanillin, Ethyl Vanillin, Maltol, Methyl: only Fraterworks averages, no stated maximum.
not_set.Calone, Ethyl 2-Methylbutyrate: the only figures have an unclear basis (fine fragrance may mean the finished product).
not_set.Patchouli EO: Good Scents has several patchouli pages; the 10% figure could not be tied to one oil.

screening_default.label: project screening default, not a safety or IFRA limit
screening_default.note: Applied by the composer only, to a liquid row whose material has no row above and no identity hard cap. It only lowers a cap, so it never loosens an IFRA limit; a row above always wins. It is a conservative bench-design screen against overdosing strong materials nobody has researched yet, not a use-level finding.

typical_use_floors.note: Raises the screening default to the project's typical dose for this material; still a screening default.
